title: YT500 instrumental — input-vs-output ABC similarity shortlist
description: Tracks whose SheetSage2 transcript is acceptably similar to its conditioning ABC. Contains only KEEP and REVIEW rows; REGENERATE and no-output tracks are listed under excluded.

decision_rules.REGENERATE: any hard invariant (truncated|sparse|no-chords|key-drift|tempo-drift) AND deep composite < 0.65
decision_rules.REVIEW: cohort outlier (composite < p05, a group < its p05, or robust z < -3) OR composite < p10
